annotations.title: Compare weather across 2-6 US places and pick the best

description: Compare weather across 2-6 US places and pick the best — Side-by-side NWS forecast for 2-6 US places for the same day, scored and ranked. places= separated by | (city names like Nashville TN|Denver CO|Miami FL, or lat,lon pairs). Optional: date= YYYY-MM-DD within 7 days (default the next daytime period), ideal_min= and ideal_max= degrees F (default 65-78). Each place gets high/low, precipitation chance, max wind, short forecast, active NWS alerts, a 0-100 comfort score, rating (EXCELLENT/GOOD/FAIR/POOR) and reasons; returns best, worst and the temperature spread. Non-US places are listed as unresolved. Source: NOAA National Weather Service (public domain). Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_compare
